content:
Hello! We are migrating bors and the queueboard backend services to new servers soon. As part of this process, we're first changing the URLs from their previous herokuapp.com addresses to the new domains under mathlib.org:

  • https://mathlib-bors-ca18eefec4cb.herokuapp.com is being replaced with https://bors.mathlib.org
  • https://queueboard-backend-7f9cf5a8499a.herokuapp.com is being replaced with https://queueboard.mathlib.org (note that this is the URL for the backend server: the URL to the dashboards at #queueboard is not changing at this time!)

I've opened PRs referencing the old URLs (and merged some of them myself).

For bors:

  • website#930, mathlib-landing#12
  • #44805
  • the Zulip linkifier #bors has already been updated

For the queueboard backend:

  • upstreaming-dashboard-action#5 This is the only place I'm aware of where the old queueboard-backend URL was referenced by downstream projects. Most users of this action reference main, which means that they won't have to do anything, but some others pinned a commit with the old URL, and they will have to be updated:
    • LeanProject#88 This one should be merged quickly so that more projects don't end up with an outdated version of upstreaming-dashboard-action
    • I found 13 GitHub repos (mostly created via the LeanProject template) which pin an outdated version of the upstreaming-dashboard-action. I've opened PRs to all of them to bump the pin.

If you know of another project that relies on these URLs (or on upstreaming-dashboard-action) please make the appropriate updates or let me know if you need help. The old URLs will continue to work for about a week or so, but since these URLs have always been somewhat internal facing, I plan to take down the heroku apps and break the old URLs when I switch to the new servers. Happy to delay / reconsider the timeline if there turn out to be more users than I expected.
I am hoping to disable the old URL in a little less than a day, so this is a final set of announcements:
@maintainers (and anyone else) if you still have bookmarks to the old bors herokuapp URL, please update them to https://bors.mathlib.org/repositories/16 soon!

It also looks like there are still requests coming in to the old queueboard URL from GitHub actions on ~20 (private?) repos that probably use an old version of the upstreaming dashboard. If you know of anyone who might have made a repo from the LeanProject template before this week, please ask them to update their version of the upstreaming-dashboard-action if they haven't already.
The migration has completed successfully and the old URLs are no longer working. Feel free to reach out if you have any issues or questions!
When I click on https://bors.mathlib.org/, I see a list of mathlib3 PRs. Is that intended?
Trying this myself right now, that is (no longer?) true.
This is what I see
Interesting: for me, everything is about mathlib4. If you clear your browser cache and reload, does the issue persist?
It's also strange that the link requires you to log in with a github account
I tried it in a different browser, and it shows the same.
What happens if you go to repositories and chose mathlib4?
Then it does show me the mathlib4 information :tada: (taking me to https://bors.mathlib.org/repositories/16)
This seems to be because "mathlib" < "mathlib4"; could mathlib3 be removed from there altogether?

Indeed, https://bors.mathlib.org shows a not-very-useful page combining PRs from all repos registered with bors and the usual dashboard is at https://bors.mathlib.org/repositories/16. I've removed mathlib3 from the list, but mathlib4-nightly-testing and bors-sandbox will stay for now.

I think most pages on bors require a login with github to access. Things might have inadvertently gotten stricter with the migration - I can look into this if we want more pages to be visible by non-logged-in users.
